question.text: A Category III AIF taking an UNHEDGED position in Credit Default Swaps must ensure that gross unhedged positions do NOT exceed:

answer.text: 25% of investable funds of the scheme
50% of investable funds of the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Circular dated January 12, 2023 caps gross unhedged CDS positions at 25% of investable funds of the scheme. The Trap: 10%/50%/100% are incorrect thresholds. Cross-Exam Context: Credit derivative exposure is unique to Cat III; Cat I/II cannot transact in CDS. Distributor's Pro-Tip: If breaching 25% is contemplated due to market conditions, intimate all unit-holders BEFORE the position is taken.
